scope_jobs.cm33_ns: everything: board init, console UART, sensors/peripherals, application logic (super-loop)
scope_jobs.cm55: booted by board_start_cm55(), runs the vendor idle loop (deep sleep) - no app code

summary: core scope cm33: application code on CM33_NS only; CM55 booted and parked in the vendor idle loop
notes: pick the CM33_NS execution model separately (baremetal-cm33 | freertos-cm33)
